create_pipeline_stable_diffusion_xl_inst: create a StableDiffusionXLInstantID pipeline that generates images conditioned on face embeddings and ControlNet keypoints
run_pipeline_call: run the pipeline __call__ method to generate images from prompts, face embeddings, and ControlNet keypoint images
load_ip_adapter_instantid: load IP adapter weights and image projection model for face identity encoding in the pipeline
set_ip_adapter_scale: set the attention scale factor for IP adapter cross-attention layers to control face identity strength
draw_kps: draw keypoints on a PIL image using face landmark coordinates and return a visualization with colored limbs and points
